source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.5.3, printed page 31.

blocks.text: Magnetic quantum number m khala mein orbital ka rukh (orientation) bayan karta hai. Subshell ke andar m ki qeemat l par munhasir hai: kisi l ke liye m ki 2l + 1 sahih qeematein hain, -l se 0 se guzar kar +l tak. m ki qeematein subshell mein orbitals ki tadaad deti hain. Agar l = 0 (s subshell) to wahid qeemat 0 hai, to s subshell mein ek orbital hai. Agar l = 1 (p) to teen qeematein hain, -1, 0 aur +1, to p subshell mein teen orbitals hain. Agar l = 2 (d) to paanch, -2, -1, 0, +1 aur +2, to d subshell mein paanch orbitals. Agar l = 3 (f) to saat, -3 se +3, to f subshell mein saat orbitals. Ek subshell ke orbitals ki energy ek jaisi hoti hai aur woh degenerate hain; maqnatisi maidan (magnetic field) ki maujoodgi mein woh ek doosre se alag pehchane jate hain, isi liye is quantum number ka yeh naam hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain
blocks.text: Maqnatisi maidan ki maujoodgi mein bareek spectral lakeeron ka tootna (splitting), aur un ka khala mein seh-jehti rukh, subshells mein orbitals ki maujoodgi ki nishandahi karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Agar n = 2 aur l = 1 to khala mein kitne rukh mumkin hain? Agar l = 2 to m ki sab qeematein aur subshell ke zyada se zyada electrons likhein.
blocks.explanation: n = 2, l = 1 2p subshell hai, m ki teen qeematon (-1, 0, +1) aur yun teen rukhon ke saath. l = 2 ke liye m ki qeematein -2, -1, 0, +1 aur +2 hain: paanch orbitals, har ek mein do electrons, to zyada se zyada das electrons.

items: m orbital ka rukh deta hai; yeh -l se +l tak chalta hai, to subshell mein 2l + 1 orbitals: s 1, p 3, d 5, f 7, sab degenerate (barabar energy) aur sirf maqnatisi maidan mein alag.
